correctness.rationale: Exact facewise equality U_i=K_i*Δ_rest is proved directly. Proper intersections contain a nonempty full simplex and are contractible; the full intersection is the product join. Induction on a finite cover using the nerve theorem and homotopy pushout gives Σ^{k-1} of the full intersection without invoking suspension cancellation. The integral Čech/Mayer–Vietoris resolution tracks permutation orientation signs, and equivariant cycle collapses plus connected graph complements establish the full wreath character. Finite mod-two chain and signed Lefschetz computations corroborate cases but are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The surviving contribution is the general *unsuspended* homotopy splitting for arbitrary finite graph-join factors, not the stabilized identity or homology ranks. Matsushita Theorem 1.2 and independence joins imply only the once-suspended statement, which is expressly excluded from novelty; homotopy suspension cancellation is invalid in general. The nearest published SCOPE join result is for open rather than closed neighborhood complexes and only complete-factor joins. Actual indexed searches did not locate the stronger unsuspended formula; unindexed folklore or general homotopy-colimit formulations remain real priority risks.

value.rationale: The statement is a uniform unstable homotopy decomposition for every finite graph join, not a one-off numerical computation. It constructs families of connected diameter-two graphs whose neighborhood complexes are spheres of arbitrarily high dimension, determines the full natural automorphism character, and provides a direct tool to transport nontrivial homotopy of constituent graph complexes. The stable source alone does not supply an unstable homotopy classification.
